order: A Safe Order of {amount} BDT was placed and the money is being held.

courier.delivered: The courier marked the parcel as delivered.
courier.in_transit: The parcel is still in transit.
courier.returned: The parcel was returned to the seller.
courier.lost: The courier reported the parcel as lost.
courier.not_dispatched: The courier has no record of the parcel being dispatched.

code.used: The buyer confirmed delivery with the delivery code.

dispute: The buyer opened a dispute on {when}.

seller.pending: The seller has not responded yet.

flags.CODE_CONTRADICTION: The courier shows delivery and the buyer entered the delivery code, but the buyer says the parcel was not received.
flags.NO_COURIER_PROOF: The seller gave no tracking number or receipt, and there is no courier record of dispatch.
flags.EVIDENCE_EMPTY_OR_VAGUE: The {party} evidence is empty or too vague to check.
flags.REPEAT_CLAIMANT: The buyer has opened {count} disputes in the last {days} days.
flags.AMOUNT_MISMATCH: An amount mentioned in the texts ({stated} BDT) does not match the order amount ({order_amount} BDT).
flags.LATE_REPORT: The dispute was filed {hours} hours after delivery.
flags.INJECTION_DETECTED: The evidence text contains instructions aimed at an AI system. They were ignored in the analysis and the case needs a human.

classes.BUYER_FALSE_CLAIM: the buyer's claim is not supported
classes.COURIER_ISSUE: the problem was caused by the courier
classes.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: there is not enough evidence to decide

model: The text model estimates {percent}% that {class_description}. This is a suggestion, not a decision.

recommendation.SUGGEST_REFUND_BUYER: Suggested outcome: refund the buyer (the held money goes back to the buyer).
recommendation.SUGGEST_REJECT_CLAIM: Suggested outcome: reject the claim (the held money goes to the seller).
recommendation.SUGGEST_COURIER_ISSUE: Suggested outcome: the problem lies with the courier. The analyst decides whether to refund the buyer or ask the seller to send again.
recommendation.NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE: Suggested outcome: ask both sides for more evidence before deciding.

route.HUMAN_REVIEW: A human analyst must review this case because: {reasons}.
route.FAST_LANE_CONFIRM: Low value, high confidence and no flags: a one-click confirmation is offered. The analyst still confirms; nothing is refunded automatically.

route_reasons.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_PREDICTED: the model predicts there is not enough evidence
route_reasons.LOW_CONFIDENCE: the model is not confident enough
route_reasons.INJECTION_DETECTED: instruction-like text was found in the evidence
